text: Read the appellate objections before extracting a damages rule. The opinion explains three remedial interests, but the actual judgment rests on a narrower set of preserved claims.
sourceSummary: A patient recovered for expenses, worsened appearance, and an additional operation after a promised cosmetic result failed. The parties’ appellate waivers limited the court’s need to choose between expectation and reliance measures.
basis: Synthesis of the cited assigned excerpt.
